name: Tanvi Foods (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2007, Tanvi Foods Ltd is in the business of manufacturing Corn Samosa, Spring Roll & Trading of Frozen Foods
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company does processing of corn based eatables such as Corn samosas, Corn patties, Spring rolls and also trades in Fresh corn, Frozen corn etc. This business is seasonal and caters to organized and unorganized markets. Company is majorly involved in supply of Frozen foods and ready to eat corn samosas, spring rolls, etc. to marriage functions and get together parties in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 0.72% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.84% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.40 Cr.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -22.4%
Working capital days have increased from 50.6 days to 79.7 days
